﻿Privacy Policy

	Last Updated: 08.12.2022
	Developer: ZDevs

=== Data Collection and Use

ZArchiver does not collect, transfer, sell personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, credit card, information about usage app or any other data. 
ZArchiver store archive passwords for some time to access encrypted files. Saved password are stored encrypted, but a hack-proof confidentiality is not guaranteed.

=== Permissions with explanation

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes.

=== Contact Us

If you have any concerns, questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at support@zdevs.ru. 
* Below is an automatic translation into Chinese. It is better to use the English version for more details.


隐私政策

	最后更新: 08.12.2022
	开发者: ZDevs

===数据收集和使用

ZArchiver不会收集、转让、出售个人信息，如您的姓名、电子邮件地址、电话号码、信用卡、使用应用程序的信息或任何其他数据。
ZArchiver会在一段时间内存储存档密码，以便访问加密文件。保存的密码是加密存储的，但不保证有防黑客的保密性。

===权限解释

READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE 和 WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android 11以前) 或 MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android 11以上) - 读取和写入外部存储器（SD卡，USB闪存）上的文件。
WAKE_LOCK - 适当工作的长期操作。
INSTALL_PACKAGES - 在安卓8以上系统中安装APK文件。
FOREGROUND_SERVICE - 运行文件操作。
POST_NOTIFICATIONS - 显示一个后台进程的进度通知。

=== 本隐私政策的变更

我们可能会不时地更新我们的隐私政策。因此，建议你定期查看本页面的任何变化。

=== 联系我们

如果你对我们的隐私政策有任何顾虑、问题或建议，请不要犹豫，与我们联系：support@zdevs.ru。
